subject: Variable number of shiny numeric input boxes (for loop?) based on another input

messages.author: 276beb20b840713c
messages.subject: Variable number of shiny numeric input boxes (for loop?) based on another input
parts:
Is there a way to generate a variable number of numeric input boxes in shiny based on another input? e.g. If user enters 3 I may want three different numeric variables to be entered by the user. If he enters 4 then four boxes etc. 

Once I get the number how can I (say) do a for loop within which  I dynamically generate a number of inputs?

Thoughts?

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: Variable number of shiny numeric input boxes (for loop?) based on another input
parts:
Use uiOutput and renderUI:

library(shiny)

# Define UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  numericInput('n', 'Enter number of additional inputs', 0),
  uiOutput('dynamic')
)

# Server logic
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$dynamic <- renderUI({
    tags <- tagList()
    for (i in seq_len(input$n)) {
      tags[[i]] <- numericInput(paste0('n', i), 
                                paste0('Input number ', i),
                                0)
    }
    tags
  })
}

# Complete app with UI and server components
shinyApp(ui, server)
